title: China releases 2024 Blue Sky Action Plan
title_cn: 中国发布《2024年蓝天保卫战行动方案》
summary: The plan outlines stricter measures for PM2.5 and ozone reduction nationwide.
summary_cn: 提出细颗粒物浓度和臭氧协同控制目标，强化多污染物统筹治理。

title: France announces green economy roadmap
title_cn: 法国发布绿色经济发展路线图
summary: Key focus on building retrofits, sustainable transport and agriculture.
summary_cn: 涵盖建筑节能、交通转型、农业碳中和等内容。

title: Singapore releases National Climate Adaptation Report 2024
title_cn: 新加坡发布国家气候适应报告2024
summary: It details strategies for sea level rise, heatwaves and water security.
summary_cn: 应对海平面上升、极端热浪、水资源安全等问题提出应对举措。
